summary: CaptionIQ MVP tested end-to-end. Primary AI feature (Whisper transcription + LLM entity tagging) PASS with real audio upload. Demo flow, semantic legend, colored words all render correctly.
ai_feature_verdicts: Whisper transcription (POST /api/transcribe) - pass - evidence: uploaded /app/test_fixtures/speech.mp3 (37056 B, gTTS speech saying 'Rahul went to Mumbai and shot a video with Priya in Delhi'); response text exactly matched 'Rahul went to Mumbai and shot a video with Priya in Delhi.' with 12 word tokens carrying start/end timestamps; curl -X POST $BASE/api/transcribe -F file=@... returned 200 - skill: ai-testing-audio

LLM entity tagging (gpt-5.4 via LlmChat) - pass - evidence: same response tagged Rahul/Priya=person, Mumbai/Delhi=location, went/shot=action; all 3 entity classes populated; skill: ai-testing-llm (covered by ai-testing-core rules)
Oversize file rejection - pass - evidence: 26MB upload returned HTTP 413 with detail 'File exceeds 25MB limit for transcription.'

Frontend demo flow - pass - evidence: /load-sample-btn click renders 24 caption-word elements with data-entity attributes (person=2, location=3, action=5, none=14); legend + caption-list + caption-line-0 all visible

minor.issue: Whisper returned 0 segments for the short mp3 (verbose_json + word timestamps present). buildLines has a fallback so single-line captions still render, but native segment timing is missing for short clips.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py transcribe endpoint: any Whisper/LLM exception is wrapped as 502; the oversized-file HTTPException(413) is inside the same try/except and would be caught & converted to 502. Verified via curl that 413 still returns correctly because HTTPException raised outside the try (size check happens before try). Good.
Frontend Studio.jsx uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly. All interactive elements carry data-testid.
SAMPLE_RESULT (mockData.js) is only used for the demo path; actual API path still exercised via file upload — confirmed real Whisper.
No MongoDB use in the transcribe path; client is instantiated but unused. Consider removing to reduce startup weight or add a real usage.
seed_data_creation: Created /app/test_fixtures/speech.mp3 (gTTS, 37 KB) with known transcript for Whisper testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE URL must be set via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://editor-rebuild-1.preview.emergentagent.com when running pytest. Fixture MP3 at /app/test_fixtures/speech.mp3 is reusable. gTTS was pip-installed to synthesize speech since ffmpeg/espeak are unavailable.
